summary.headline: Configuration Manager OS deployment site-role guidance receives a minor update
summary.overview: The day contains a single documentation maintenance update to the Configuration Manager guidance for preparing site system roles for operating-system deployment.
summary.adminImpact: No immediate configuration change is evidenced. Use the current page when planning OSD infrastructure or validating site-system role prerequisites.

keyChanges.title: OS deployment site-system role guidance is maintained
keyChanges.detail: The Configuration Manager preparation reference receives a small update and remains the current source for planning required site roles for operating-system deployment.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager 2509 diagnostic-data guidance and Autopilot workflow documentation expand
summary.overview: A new 2509 diagnostic-and-usage-data reference dominates the day, with updates to Autopilot device-preparation automatic workflow, certificate connector guidance, device query, and Intune release documentation.
summary.adminImpact: Configuration Manager administrators should use the new 2509 data-collection guidance when reviewing privacy, telemetry, or support requirements. Autopilot teams should refresh automatic device-preparation runbooks from the current workflow documentation.

keyChanges.title: Diagnostic and usage data guidance is added for Configuration Manager 2509
keyChanges.detail: The new 2509 reference establishes an updated source for understanding diagnostic and usage data collection in that Configuration Manager release.

keyChanges.title: Autopilot device-preparation automatic workflow is updated
keyChanges.detail: The automatic workflow tutorial receives follow-up changes, keeping the current device-preparation sequence and support guidance available for Autopilot administrators.

summary.headline: Intune publishes a Zero Trust deployment approach and Windows diagnostic-data guidance
summary.overview: The day adds a Zero Trust deployment approach and a Windows diagnostic-data article, then updates associated security, filters, certificate connector, Configuration Manager, and enrollment references.
summary.adminImpact: Use the new Zero Trust plan as a structured reference when sequencing identity, device, application, and data-protection work rather than treating it as a new enforcement feature. Review Windows diagnostic-data configuration alongside reporting and update-policy prerequisites, particularly where privacy and telemetry policy is tightly governed.

keyChanges.title: Zero Trust deployment approach with Intune is added
keyChanges.detail: The new deployment-plan guidance provides a structured Intune reference for configuring security in a Zero Trust approach and is accompanied by updates to the related Zero Trust security documentation.

keyChanges.title: Windows diagnostic-data guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: A new tenant-administration article documents Windows diagnostic data, creating a clearer reference for administrators balancing reporting and feature prerequisites with data-governance requirements.

summary.headline: Intune rebuilds its privacy, data-sharing, and compliance documentation
summary.overview: Fifteen new pages reorganize Intune privacy and governance guidance around data collection, storage, secure sharing, data exchanges with partners, personal-data rights, audit/export/delete, and regulatory alignment. This is a major information-architecture improvement for compliance and privacy work.
summary.adminImpact: Privacy, legal, and endpoint teams should update their compliance evidence and data-flow runbooks to use the new privacy and governance paths. Review the new data-sharing pages for each integrated ecosystem—Apple, Google, Zebra, and Jamf—and align customer, regulator, and auditor responses with the current descriptions.

keyChanges.title: Data security and sharing guide is added
keyChanges.detail: A new privacy guide explains Intune data security and sharing and joins a broader set of partner-specific data-flow pages covering data exchanged with Apple, Google, Zebra, and Jamf.

keyChanges.title: Compliance and regulatory alignment guide is added
keyChanges.detail: The new governance reference provides an Intune-focused entry point for compliance and regulatory alignment, complementing the privacy, data-handling, and personal-data documentation refresh.

keyChanges.title: Cloud PKI and Configuration Manager references are updated alongside the privacy work
keyChanges.detail: The day also refreshes Cloud PKI and on-premises-infrastructure upgrade documentation, ensuring linked operational guidance remains aligned with the new governance material.

summary.headline: Configuration-profile deployment planning and Azure Monitor log review guidance are refined
summary.overview: The day’s updates focus on the configuration-profile deployment plan, Azure Monitor log-review guidance, supported-app documentation, and minor Configuration Manager and reporting reference maintenance.
summary.adminImpact: Use the revised configuration-profile plan when documenting implementation phases and owner responsibilities. Ensure monitoring runbooks use the current Azure Monitor log guidance before depending on them for rollout validation or troubleshooting.

keyChanges.title: Configuration-profile deployment plan is substantially revised
keyChanges.detail: The deployment-plan article receives multiple substantial updates, keeping the current structured guidance for planning, creating, assigning, and validating Intune configuration profiles.

keyChanges.title: Azure Monitor log-review guidance is expanded
keyChanges.detail: The Intune log-review documentation adds material for reviewing operational evidence with Azure Monitor, supporting more consistent monitoring and troubleshooting procedures.
